summary: mutation_gate failed on the measurement branch with 'could not find any test case for any mutant'. Root cause: scripts/mutation_engine.py wrote only_mutate as a comma-separated line, and mutmut 3.8.0 treats that as a single glob pattern (it only splits on newlines), so with two required files (app.py and search.py) no file matched and mutmut mutated 0 files. With one file it worked by accident. The config now writes one pattern per line. Added a test for the multi-file config. Measured locally on the measurement branch's files: 104 mutants, app.py 95.56% and search.py 84.75% killed, mutation_ci passed.
